review.notes: Full review. Sources: DLMF 29.1, 29.2, 29.3, 29.5, 29.6, 29.8, 29.9, 29.10, 29.12, 29.14, 29.15, 29.17 read at every cited equation (all correct); Whittaker-Watson Ch. XXIII read in the 3rd edition (13 locators, 2 wrong); Dassios, Gesztesy-Holden, Ronveaux, Kristensson not readable. All 15 sampled targets checked; eigenvalues, duality, coexistence signs, k->1 limits, double orthogonality and Whittaker's ratio recomputed by independent shooting; Hermite's invariant recomputed exactly for n = 0..5. Findings: ratio limit of 3.2 false at nu = -2n-1 (hypothesis nu >= -1/2 dropped, also in lameEc_even_fourier); wrong zero count in the proof sketch of 4.4; Mathieu 7.3 cited for a continued fraction it does not supply. Targeted build passes (22 sorry warnings); depcheck 0 problems; one-tactic probe closes none; the two automatic-check hits (choice in lameHermitePoly, header over #check lines) set aside with reasons.
